capabilities: Render chess boards from chess code blocks
Play and edit moves on the board
Draw annotations like arrows and circles
extras: README has a TODO section listing planned PGN file support; PGN must be formatted as multiline YAML in the code block.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display or play through chess positions and games within notes.
summary: Chess game viewer and editor that renders FEN or PGN positions as interactive boards inside chess code blocks.
